# Crates whose generated Rust still holds a reference count or a runtime
# cell (Rc, RefCell or rt::Ptr). The project lead's bar is Rust as a person
# writes it, with neither (RFC 0017), so this list only shrinks:
# TestNoSharedCells fails if a crate not listed here has one, and if a
# listed crate no longer does. Each line is a crate's directory and why.
testdata/golden-lib/inventory	pointer cells (RFC 0013); interface values
